Visualization 2.0 converts supplied 2D/3D trajectories into four
journal-oriented plots with exact source-row and QC policy linkage.
The example dataset below is **synthetic**, not measured fish movement.
The four figures below are rendered by the package during the website build;
the full executable R Markdown source is linked above.

## Journal starting-point presets

The returned journal-style widths and raster DPI are reproducible
technical defaults, not a promise of compliance with a named publisher.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(aquaTrajectories)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,fig.width=8,fig.height=5,
                      fig.align="center",out.width="100%",
                      dpi=150,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE)
```

```{r presets}
knitr::kable(aqt_viz2_presets(),
  caption="Reproducible figure-size and raster-resolution presets")
```

## One reviewed data source, four native figures

The fish observations include a deliberately missing position and a
source-frame discontinuity. Neither can form a movement line segment.

```{r input}
time <- 0:12
rows <- do.call(rbind,lapply(1:3,function(i) {
  x <- .5*i + .2*time + .15*sin(time/2+i)
  y <- i + .35*cos(time/2+i)
  observed <- !(i==2L & time==5L)
  data.frame(session_id="SYNTHETIC",camera_id="TOP",
    track_id=paste0("fish",i),frame_id=time+as.integer(time>=8),
    time_s=time,x=ifelse(observed,x,NA_real_),
    y=ifelse(observed,y,NA_real_),observed=observed,
    source_row=paste0(i,"-",time))
}))
tracks <- aqt_tracks(rows,units="cm",coordinate_system="tank")
qc <- aqt_qc2_report(tracks,gap_limits_s=1.01,speed_limits=2)
stopifnot(nrow(qc$lineage)==nrow(rows))
```

### QC-eligible spatial path segments

```{r viz2-paths, fig.alt="Native observed-position trajectories, broken at missing and excluded steps", fig.cap="Observed synthetic positions with lines only for QC-eligible steps."}
paths <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure="paths",policy_id="QC001",
                       preset="journal_double")
aqt_viz2_draw(paths)
```

### Only eligible speed measurements

```{r viz2-speed, fig.alt="Observed speed from only valid source steps", fig.cap="Synthetic movement speeds calculated exclusively from QC-eligible steps."}
speed <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure="speed",policy_id="QC001")
aqt_viz2_draw(speed)
```

### Source-row coverage

```{r viz2-coverage, fig.alt="Exact eligible, excluded and nonestimable source-row coverage", fig.cap="Original source-row eligibility and missingness by synthetic track."}
coverage <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure="qc_coverage",
                          policy_id="QC001")
aqt_viz2_draw(coverage)
```

### Complete QC reason classification

```{r viz2-reasons, fig.alt="QC decision reason frequency for original rows", fig.cap="Exclusion and non-estimability reasons retained from the QC ledger."}
reasons <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure="qc_reasons",
                         policy_id="QC001")
aqt_viz2_draw(reasons)
```

## Transactional source-linked export

The following code creates both vector and raster artwork, plus the
input row, eligible-movement and full QC decision evidence. It refuses
to overwrite an existing directory.

```r
aqt_viz2_export(paths, "manuscript_figure_1",
                formats=c("pdf","svg","png","tiff"))
stopifnot(aqt_viz2_verify("manuscript_figure_1"))
```

If the original source file, sealed specification or output file is
modified without a new scientific audit, validation fails.
All 22 existing public native plotting functions are documented in the
[complete public plotting gallery](all-plot-functions.html).

For scientific and publisher limitations, consult the
[Publication Visualization 2.0 methods](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/main/docs/PUBLICATION_VISUALIZATION_2_0.md).
